messages:
sophia: Heads-up — we had ~12 P1 pages in the last 6h from the model-serving kv-cache-flap alert. Mostly short-lived bursts (30–90s) that still wake people up. Can we decide a short-term pruning strategy and an owner for follow-ups?
rahul: ack. is this the alert that triggers on >5x spike in cache miss rate?
sophia: yes. rule name: model_serving.kv_cache.flap. It's sensitive to GC/backpressure; pattern is small bursts during autoscale events.
liam: quick thought — add a 3m sustained threshold and a 10m suppression window for duplicate firing? that should prevent 1–2min blips from paging.
elaine: agree. also we should add a dedupe key so retries from the same instance don't create separate pages.
rahul: proposed patch (pseudo):
```
alert: kv_cache_flap_paging
expr: increase(kv_cache_miss_rate[3m]) > 5
for: 180s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "KV cache flap (>5x)"
```
and then suppression: 600s for same alert fingerprint.
liam: can we make the for: configurable per cluster? small clusters might need lower for.
sophia: yes — we'll parameterize via alert_metadata. immediate action: rahul to open PR against prometheus/alerts with the 3m/10m change. owner for follow-ups: elaine will own postmortem/follow-up items and tracking.
rahul: opening PR now, linking test plan & screenshots.
oncall-bot: Deploy notice — alert rules updated in staging by rahul at 1766012200.
elaine: action items I have noted: 1) update runbook to include flap handling (by EOD tomorrow) 2) add dedupe key in alert template (by next Tue) 3) schedule a 30m sync on Fri to review pager metrics and decide if we can relax thresholds further.
sophia: tagging existing recurring pattern: model-serving/kv-cache-flap in remediation tracker. please add recent incidents + graphs.
liam: I can export the 6h/24h firing frequency graphs and drop into the ticket.
rahul: PR link: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/432 — includes change + staging validation logs.
elaine: assigning follow-ups: runbook (elaine), dedupe key (rahul + liam), graphs + data (liam). ETA: runbook EOD tomorrow, dedupe PR next Tue, data posted before Fri sync.
sophia: thanks — if the staging change looks good, can we roll to prod tomorrow morning US-west off-peak? rahul?
rahul: plan to roll at 09:00 PT tomorrow with canary on two clusters first. will post deploy note.
liam: one more ask — add a short blurb to oncall playbook about "flap vs sustained" so triage knows to suppress short blips. I'll draft a paragraph.
elaine: added to my runbook task.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: incident-sync Friday 15:00 UTC — attendees: sophia, elaine, liam, rahul.
sophia: perfect. after the sync, elaine to close the remediation ticket with final owner list and follow-up timeline.
rahul: will monitor pager noise this evening and drop a quick update if anything regresses.
liam: thanks team. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks — will update the tracker and ping the channel when tasks are done. :white_check_mark:
